title: Hotel, Mall, casino hybrid
content: I'm actually freaking out reading all these because Ive seen a lot of this stuff in my dreams too! I see a hotel, casino, mall hybrid. The hotel is like 100 stories and everything connects somehow. There's a lobby area with a reception desk and then the casino area. All the rails and hardware are gold. I always get a weird uneasy feeling being here as well. Like I'm not supposed to be there but it feels so familiar The mall is also like a really nice mall, a lot of marble. I can like barely type this out without it making me feel weird. Everything is like a red velvet color & feeling too. I also see a lot of these staircases.
